title: 第149章 万剑归宗第148章 蚍蜉终究可以撼动大树
slug: 加入合欢宗后师妹的鱼塘炸了
content_zh:
第149章万剑归宗
一场大战，昏天黑地。
两股不同的势力碰撞在一起，又如万千流星坠落。
仙族强悍，但数量上却不占优势，一时无法突破防线。
灼尧见自己的人无法干扰大阵，龙尾全力一甩，静笃三人便同时倒飞出去。
趁三人还没缠上来，他将目标转向孤鸢一行人。
“既然你们非要出这个头，那本座就提前送你们上西天！”
他一出手，在前抵挡的修士立刻溃不成军。
云洛眼看熙熙的赐福还差一点，咬了咬牙，提剑挡了上去。
一声巨响，她长吐一口血，倒飞进人群，溅起漫天尘土。
“阿洛！”
人群里传来几声惊呼，大家一边维持大阵，一边焦急朝她望来。
“呵，不自量力。”
灼尧鼻子里挤出冷气，巨大的龙身直立而起，利爪在空中划出无数吞噬之空。
这些裂缝，不仅能吸收术法，同样也能将人吸进去，然后化作虚无，是他身为上神才能掌握的神通。
无数裂口同时形成的引力将所有人整齐向前吸了一大步。
“不要被吸进去！”
有人喊了一声，大家不得不暂缓向九曲黄河阵输送法力，结阵抵挡裂缝的吞噬。
但灼尧现在发了狠，阵法只是减缓了他们往裂缝挪动的速度。
这样下去，不出三息，最前面的修士就会被裂缝吞噬。

而就在他们快要贴近裂缝时，一道无比耀眼的金光从人群中间爆发。
金光似剑气荡开，势如破竹将无形引力逼退，直至裂缝被一道道荡平。
最前排的修士松了口气，抬头，竟见头顶站了一排排身披战甲、罩着黄金面具的金甲战士。
祂们身形各异，但各个气宇轩昂，不怒自威。
“这些是……”
刚刚被灼尧那么打他们都没迷糊，现在反而有些看不懂了。
这些人哪儿来的？
裴砚清单手擦掉嘴角的血迹，目光精准落在刚刚云洛降落的地方。
“是她。”
大家立刻反应过来，人群自动让开一条道。
身形高挑的人撑着剑起身，肩头一只似狐似犬的小兽死死抓着衣服的布料，背上小角亮如明珠。
刚刚云洛硬接灼尧一击，熙熙硬是顶着压力，才没有让赐福中断，否则，功亏一篑。
“娘亲，坚持住，就一会儿了。”
熙熙紧咬牙关，身子抖得让云洛也像是在风中摇曳。
“好。”
content_en:
Chapter 149 Ten thousand swords return to the clan
A big battle, dark and dark.
Two different forces collided together and fell like thousands of meteors.
The immortals were strong, but they did not have an advantage in numbers and were unable to break through the defense line for a while.
When Zhuo Yao saw that his men could not interfere with the formation, he swung the dragon's tail with all his strength, and Jing Du and the other three flew out at the same time.
Before the three of them got entangled, he turned his target to Gu Yuan and his party.
"Since you insist on doing this, I will send you to the West in advance!"
As soon as he took action, the monks who were resisting him were instantly defeated.
Seeing that Xixi's blessing was still a little short of the mark, Yun Luo gritted his teeth and raised his sword to block it.
With a loud noise, she vomited a mouthful of blood and flew backwards into the crowd, splashing dust all over the sky.
"Arlo!"
Several exclamations came from the crowd, and everyone looked at her anxiously while maintaining their formation.
"Oh, you don't overestimate your capabilities."
Zhuo Yao squeezed out cold air from his nose, and the huge dragon body stood upright, with its sharp claws drawing countless swallowing holes in the air.
These cracks can not only absorb spells, but can also suck people in and turn them into nothingness. This is a magical power that he can only master as a god.
The gravitational force formed by countless cracks at the same time pulled everyone forward in a big step.
"Don't get sucked in!"
Someone shouted, and everyone had to postpone sending mana to the Jiuqu Yellow River Formation to form an formation to resist the devouring of the cracks.
But Zhuo Yao was now fierce, and the formation only slowed down their movement towards the crack.
If this continues, within three breaths, the monk at the front will be swallowed by the crack.
And just when they were about to get close to the crack, an extremely dazzling golden light burst out from the middle of the crowd.
The golden light spread out like a sword, and the force was like breaking bamboo, forcing the invisible gravity back until the cracks were flattened one after another.
The monks in the front row breathed a sigh of relief, looked up, and saw rows of golden-armored warriors wearing battle armor and golden masks standing above their heads.
They have different body shapes, but each one is majestic and majestic.
"These are..."
They were all confused after being beaten so hard by Zhuo Yao just now, but now they can't understand.
Where did these people come from?
Pei Yanliang wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth with his hand, and his eyes fell precisely on the place where Yun Luo landed just now.
"It's her."
Everyone reacted immediately and the crowd automatically moved out of the way.
The tall man stood up with his sword in hand. A small fox-like dog-like beast on his shoulder was clutching the fabric of his clothes. The small horn on his back was as bright as a pearl.
Just now Yunluo received Zhuo Yao's blow forcefully, Xixi had to endure the pressure and not let the blessing be interrupted, otherwise, the success would be in vain.
"Mom, hold on, it's just a moment."
Xixi gritted her teeth and her body was shaking so much that Yunluo seemed to be swaying in the wind.
"good."
